name: @homie-rocks/studio
description: A studio for games, music and video on its own Cloudflare: scaffold, multiplayer starters on the netplay contract, a port toolkit that makes existing single-player web games multiplayer, the site Worker with public rooms (Table/Lobby Durable Objects and D1, all on the free Workers plan, no payment method), song and video pages from the music/ and videos/ manifests, optional R2 storage for large media, deploy, and the homie.rocks directory.
